description:
On the /fly route, the left-rail HUD panel's velocity readout displays 'NaN km/s' for the entire duration of outer-planet missions (Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune, Pluto, Ceres). The same readout shows correct values (e.g. ~29.78 km/s) for Earth, Moon, and Mars missions

Expected: The HUD velocity readout shows the spacecraft's vis-viva speed computed from its current heliocentric distance and the actual destination-appropriate Hohmann transfer semi-major axis

Acceptance criteria:
- A Galileo mission (Jupiter, ~5.2 AU) at any point during cruise shows a finite number > 0 km/s, not NaN [reporter: 'Flying out to the outer planets, the HUD speed readout just says "NaN km/s" the whole way']
- A Voyager 2 mission (Neptune, ~30 AU) at any point during cruise shows a finite number > 0 km/s, not NaN [reporter: same report — 'outer planets' includes Neptune]
- The transfer semi-major axis passed as the second argument to flyHeliocentricSpeed for non-Moon missions equals (R_EARTH_AU + DESTINATIONS[activeDestination].a) / 2, using the actual destination orbital radius from the DESTINATIONS registry — not the hardcoded Earth-Mars Hohmann value [code-invariant: Existing code at fly/+page.svelte:952 computes a_transfer = (R_EARTH_AU + R_MARS_AU) / 2 for all non-Moon missions (Hohmann formula). The same Hohmann formula applied to each destination's orbital radius (DESTINATIONS[activeDestination].a, from planets.json via lambert-grid.constants.ts) is the correct generalization to all 9+ destinations.]
- The ORRERY-1 default Mars free-return scenario still shows ~32.7 km/s at Earth departure (r=1.0 AU on the Earth-Mars Hohmann) — existing Earth/Mars behavior is not regressed [spec: static/data/scenarios/orrery-1.json is the default fly scenario; unit test at fly-physics.test.ts:32-34 expects heliocentricSpeed(1.0, 1.262) ≈ 32.73 km/s]
- Moon-mode missions (isMoonMission=true) still show ~29.78 km/s — the R_EARTH_AU branch for both arguments (line 952) remains valid [code-invariant: src/routes/fly/+page.svelte lines 950-953: isMoonMission passes R_EARTH_AU as both r and a, which is always in the valid domain]

Target: src/routes/fly/+page.svelte — heliocentricKms $derived block at line 951
